john.doe (Customer): Hey team — my trial credits vanished after a billing reversal yesterday. I had ~ $120 in trial credits and now balance is 0.0. I still have a few tests to run for POC, can someone check?

alex (CS): Sorry to hear that, John. Can you share your account id and the invoice id you got the reversal for?

john.doe (Customer): Sure — account `acct_9F4aB0` and invoice `INV-2026-1147`. I got an email: "Payment of $50.00 was reversed due to dispute" around 2026-03-14. Credits dropped immediately after that.

billing-bot: Payment reversal processed for invoice `INV-2026-1147` (amount: $50.00) by processor at 2026-03-14T18:22:11Z.

marta (Billing): Hi @john.doe, thanks for the info. When a payment is reversed we sometimes auto-adjust promotional balances depending on the reversal reason. I can check the ledger — giving me a minute.

sam (Engineer): From infra side there are no hooks that would zero out trial credits except the billing reconciliation job. No API errors logged. If billing confirms adjustment I can help with a manual credit top-up.

alex (CS): Marta — can you confirm whether this was an automated policy adjustment vs manual? Customer says credits were used for test runs and they'd like an extension or reinstatement to finish POC.

marta (Billing): Confirmed: reversal flagged as "chargeback" by payment processor which triggered the auto-reconciliation script. That script currently removes promotional credit proportional to the reversal amount if invoice used promotional balance. In this case promo credits were used for part of invoice, so they were removed.

john.doe (Customer): That's surprising — I didn't initiate a dispute. The chargeback looks like it was from my bank mistakenly. Is there a policy to appeal? I can share the bank case id if needed.

alex (CS): Yes — we can escalate for review. Please share bank case id and any dispute emails. If it's a mistaken chargeback we can consider reinstating credits as a goodwill gesture while billing reviews.

john.doe (Customer): Bank case `BK-7781023`. I uploaded the dispute confirmation to the support portal (ticket #CS-8402). Thanks.

marta (Billing): Got it. I'll open a manual review with finance. Two actions: 1) start chargeback investigation, 2) provision temporary goodwill credits so you can finish your tests. Can you confirm how many tokens/credits you need to finish POC?

john.doe (Customer): Thanks — estimate ~ $30 worth of credits for the next 48 hours. Appreciate the quick help.

marta (Billing): Ok, creating a manual grant of $30 in trial credits valid for 7 days while we investigate. I'll add an internal note on invoice `INV-2026-1147` and link ticket CS-8402.

billing-bot: Manual credit grant created: amount $30.00, reason: temporary_grant_chargeback_review, expires: 2026-03-21T23:59:59Z. Grant id: `GR-33021`.

alex (CS): Sweet — John, you should see the $30 in your account now. Let us know if the tests still fail. We'll keep this open until the billing team completes the review. :thumbsup:

john.doe (Customer): I see the $30, thanks everyone! Really appreciate the fast turnaround.

marta (Billing): Follow-up: if the chargeback is reversed in your favor we will keep the promo balance; if the reversal stands we may need to reconcile and prorate. We will update ticket CS-8402 with final decision.

sam (Engineer): Tagging this thread for telemetry — if you see any weird client-side quota errors please paste logs.

alex (CS): Closing loop for now. Reopening if billing needs anything else. 

(ends)
